verdict: Leads and cost per lead improved, but key tracking work is overdue.
narrative: In the last 28 days, you received 122 leads at a cost of $11.90 each — a 26% improvement in cost per lead compared to the prior 7-day stretch. That efficiency gain came alongside a pullback in daily spend, so volume dipped modestly; the two moves largely offset each other. On the organic side, your Google Business Profile drove 195 actions including 59 calls this period, though activity went quiet over the last three days and is being watched closely. Two tracking milestones — lead source attribution and CRM contact cleanup — are past their due dates, which means the pipeline numbers on hand are not yet reliable; both are being completed now so the August scoreboard is clean before the end-of-month decision point.
